name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-ancient-cave-rocky-wall
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Ancient Cave (Rocky Wall)
description:
A very simple but effective rocky wall background seen in the Ancient Cave, from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. Uses only 10 tiles, meaning a lot of space for foreground decoration.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
